description_for_human: Email infrastructure for AI agents — send and receive email, get a managed inbox, and run code on inbound mail.
description_for_model: Use Primitive to send and receive email programmatically as an AI agent: get a managed *.primitive.email address, send a message and wait for the threaded reply, list and read received email, and deploy hosted Functions that run on every inbound message. No SMTP, DNS, or mail server required. The authenticated REST API is described in the linked OpenAPI spec; an agent can self-serve an anonymous identity via the agent-signup flow documented at https://www.primitive.dev/auth.md.
